finding: Cesarean hysterectomy for PAS is associated with placental bulge and Grade 2 and 3 intracervical hypervascularity, while OSCS is associated with intracervical hypervascularity Grade 1 on transvaginal ultrasound.
mod_finding: Cesarean hysterectomy is associated with certain placental ultrasound signs, while one-step conservative surgery (OSCS) is associated with intracervical hypervascularity Grade 1 on transvaginal ultrasound in cases of placenta accreta spectrum.
